from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
base='b8a787b5b6c9df5bda03db4b5c9f3da67d80317a'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
script=r'''
import asyncio,json
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await browser.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):
     await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   response=await page.goto(url,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   fields=await page.locator("input,select,textarea").evaluate_all("""els=>els.map(e=>({tag:e.tagName.toLowerCase(),type:(e.getAttribute('type')||'').toLowerCase(),required:e.required||e.getAttribute('aria-required')==='true',label:(e.labels&&e.labels[0]&&e.labels[0].innerText||e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').trim().slice(0,90)}))""")
   # Only structural metadata: no entered values, DOM snapshots, cookies, or candidate data.
   filtered=[f for f in fields if f["type"] not in ("hidden","password")]
   print(json.dumps({"status":response.status if response else None,"host":urlsplit(page.url).hostname,"field_count":len(fields),"visible_field_type_counts":{kind:sum(f["type"]==kind for f in filtered) for kind in sorted({f["type"] for f in filtered})},"required_field_count":sum(f["required"] for f in filtered),"required_field_labels":[f["label"] for f in filtered if f["required"] and f["label"]][:30],"auth":"not_attempted","form_filling":"not_attempted","submission":"not_attempted","review":"not_verified"},sort_keys=True))
  finally:await browser.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',script],cwd=repo,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=65)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
 raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-6500:],'ERROR',e[-900:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('READONLY_DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['host']=='jobs.lever.co' and r['status']==200 and r['field_count']>=1
assert r['auth']=='not_attempted' and r['form_filling']=='not_attempted' and r['submission']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('READONLY_FORM_STRUCTURE_VERIFIED',flush=True)
